summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K to incorporate into its Form F-3ASR an underwriting agreement dated November 4, 2026 for a two-tranche senior debt offering: $1.25 billion of 5.511% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2030 and $1.5 billion of 5.715% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2032, $2.75 billion combined. Underwriters represented by Barclays, BMO, Lloyds Securities, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley and Scotiabank. This is a routine shelf takedown of callable senior notes, not a special situation; no equity, change-of-control or strategic terms are present. Watch nothing deal-related; relevance is limited to the group's funding and liability-management profile.
